title: Potential therapeutic benefits of Murraya exotica L. extract on type II collagen-induced arthritis.
authors: Wu, Guoping; Fan, Yuxin; Yao, Yawen; Ma, Qiushuo; Chen, Qiling; Chen, Junming; Xie, Wenbo; Yu, Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究九里香提取物对胶原诱导关节炎的治疗作用，涉及NF-kB/AP-1通路与分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅分子对接为边缘方法。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic, progressive autoimmune disorder characterized by persistent synovial inflammation, pannus formation, bone erosion, and eventual joint destruction. Murraya exotica L. (ME), a botanical source of Murrayae Folium et Cacumen (MFC), has not been previously investigated for its anti-arthritic potential, which motivated this study. The chemical composition of ME was characterized using ultra-performance liquid chromatography (UPLC), and its anti-arthritic effects were evaluated in collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rats and interleukin (IL)-1beta-stimulated SW982 cells. The contents of meranzin hydrate, hainanmurpanin, murrayone, and 3',4',5,5',6,7-hexamethoxyflavone in the ME extract were quantified as 2.86% +/- 0.01%, 1.88% +/- 0.01%, 0.07% +/- 0.00%, and 0.01% +/- 0.00%, respectively. In CIA rats, ME treatment alleviated clinical symptoms, attenuated histopathological joint damage, including synovial hyperplasia, cartilage degeneration, and bone erosion, ameliorated inflammation, and reduced oxidative stress. In IL-1beta-stimulated SW982 cells, ME inhibited proliferation and migration, suppressed the inflammatory response, and mitigated oxidative stress. Network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses predicted strong interactions between ME-derived compounds (e.g., murrayone) and nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) p65, which were further validated by cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assay. Mechanistically, ME blocked NF-kappaB activation by inhibiting phosphorylation and degradation of inhibitor of NF-kappaB-alpha (IkappaBalpha) and preventing p65 nuclear translocation, while simultaneously suppressing activator protein-1 (AP-1) activation through downregulation of c-Fos and c-Jun. The involvement of the NF-kappaB and AP-1 pathways in ME-mediated anti-inflammatory, anti-proliferative, and anti-oxidative effects in RA was further confirmed using specific pharmacological inhibitors: pyrrolidinedithiocarbamate (PDTC) for NF-kappaB and SR11302 for AP-1.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性、进行性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为持续性滑膜炎症、血管翳形成、骨侵蚀及最终关节破坏。九里香（Murraya exotica L.，ME）作为九里香叶及茎（Murrayae Folium et Cacumen，MFC）的植物来源，其抗关节炎潜力此前尚未被研究，这促使了本研究开展。采用超高效液相色谱（UPLC）对ME的化学成分进行表征，并在胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠及白细胞介素（IL）-1β刺激的SW982细胞中评估其抗关节炎作用。ME提取物中meranzin hydrate、hainanmurpanin、murrayone及3',4',5,5',6,7-hexamethoxyflavone的含量分别定量为2.86% ± 0.01%、1.88% ± 0.01%、0.07% ± 0.00%和0.01% ± 0.00%。在CIA大鼠中，ME治疗缓解了临床症状，减轻了组织病理学关节损伤（包括滑膜增生、软骨退变和骨侵蚀），改善了炎症，并降低了氧化应激。在IL-1β刺激的SW982细胞中，ME抑制了增殖和迁移，抑制了炎症反应，并减轻了氧化应激。网络药理学和分子对接分析预测了ME来源化合物（如murrayone）与核因子-κB（NF-κB）p65之间的强相互作用，并通过细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）分析进一步验证。机制上，ME通过抑制NF-κB-α抑制剂（IκBα）的磷酸化和降解以及阻止p65核转位来阻断NF-κB激活，同时通过下调c-Fos和c-Jun抑制激活蛋白-1（AP-1）激活。使用特异性药理学抑制剂：吡咯烷二硫代氨基甲酸酯（PDTC）用于NF-κB和SR11302用于AP-1，进一步证实了NF-κB和AP-1通路在ME介导的RA抗炎、抗增殖和抗氧化作用中的参与。
